import os
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p),exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        marks = [c for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 6]
        for a, b in zip(marks, marks[1:]):
            if b - a == 2:
                out[r][a + 1] = 2
    return out
'''
open(p,'w').write(code)
grid=[[3]*11 for _ in range(13)]
for r,cs in {3:[1,3,5],5:[0,2,4,6],7:[0,2,4],9:[5,7],11:[0,2,4,6],12:[5,7]}.items():
